LESSON: THE TEN COMMANDMENTS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.2: The Ten Commandments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Ten Commandments
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you obey the Ten Commandments?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments
2. appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments

Teach
• Today’s focus: identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments” using a school example.
• Model B for “identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments
• Model 2: appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments
2. Practise: appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for The Ten Commandments.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you obey the Ten Commandments?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• identify values and life skills in the Ten Commandments
• appreciate the importance of obeying the Ten Commandments

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
